response.text: My biggest technical challenge was at UBA Group—re-architecting legacy IBM workloads (ACE/MQ) to run on Kubernetes. These were stateful, complex applications never designed for containers. I had to design custom StatefulSets, implement persistent storage with Longhorn, set up air-gap simulation, and prove to enterprise stakeholders that their critical banking infrastructure could run in a cloud-native way. The eureka moment? When we achieved 99.9% uptime in production testing.
